phases.title: Project charter, research lock & plan control
phases.goal: Lock the authoritative problem interpretation, success criteria, project identity, and planning conventions before any modeling work is split across workstreams.
phases.validation_gate: Source priority documented; normalized spec present; rubric weights locked; project identity/domain locked; plan.md, phase files, TRACKER.csv, and status.json cross-linked; all phases Verified.

phases.title: Data, environment & reproducibility baseline
phases.goal: Establish a clean, reproducible foundation from the official workbook, pinned dependencies, seed manifest, and lean repo layout.
phases.validation_gate: Workbook at data/raw with 5 sheets and zero nulls; train/test IDs disjoint; requirements.txt pinned; seeds.json exact; py_compile passed; make_report ran; reproducibility score 100%.

phases.title: Stage 1 — calibrated hybrid prediction
phases.goal: Produce one continuous, leakage-free probability vector for all 100 test customers, rank the top 10, and lock the Stage 1 metric suite.
phases.validation_gate: 3×5 stratified OOF CV only; 100 unique test IDs; deterministic rank with customer_id tie-break; top-10 flag exactly 10 rows; winner rank_calibrated_hybrid composite 0.447516; metrics match benchmark_metrics.csv.

phases.title: Stage 2 — certified quantum-assisted selection
phases.goal: Choose exactly six of the top 10 customers maximizing expected net value under budget and capacity, with a disclosed QAOA run and an exact classical certificate.
phases.validation_gate: Six unique IDs from top 10; Σcost=11≤25; Σcapacity=16≤22; exact objective 45.78743946915947; 210/210 subsets checked; raw QAOA gap 5.047731581776915 disclosed; certified hybrid gap 0.0.

phases.title: Stage 3 — six-qubit conversion simulation
phases.goal: Estimate Pr(K ≥ 3) with one qubit per selected customer and verify the result against exact, ideal, finite-shot, Monte Carlo, noisy, and mitigated references.
phases.validation_gate: Exact 0.4164131424084104; ideal 0.4164131424084103; Aer 0.420379638671875; mitigated error 0.004014931 < noisy error 0.014922307; 6 qubits, depth 1, 0 two-qubit/SWAP gates; bit order stated; full counts preserved.

phases.title: End-to-end integration, 30-metric benchmark & validation
phases.goal: Bind the three stages into one traceable system, publish the 30-metric evidence table, and lock the reproducibility and honesty checks.
phases.validation_gate: 30/30 engineering gates passed; reproducibility 100%; exact Stage 2 gap 0.0; exact Stage 3 reference present; ID traceability intact; no unsupported quantum-advantage claim; runtime 145.9735 s recorded.

phases.title: Technical communication, evidence pack & submission handoff
phases.goal: Present the project as a coherent, professional, reproducible story with exact values, visual evidence, and external handoffs consistent with the lean repo.
phases.validation_gate: Exact values consistent across README, docs, results, and external media; 21 diagram sources and branded gallery plates present in the external pack; no unsupported advantage claim; lean repo remains under budget; README points to docs/plan/.
